title: A decision line Home: rule:<anchor> counts as a home.
ruling: Triage ruling, reported in a review note on PR 2915 posted 21:32 CST Nov 12 (the time of the comment): a decision whose Home line names a rule anchor, such as Home: rule:git-cite-by-id, has a home, so the tending runner must not treat it as a file path and flag it stale. The review round 3 note repeats it as a triage ruling used.
